D-091-R001: The cloud loop can run dual review behind its existing reviewer seam: loop.py gains one optional review_conductor parameter (default None keeps the single-Codex-reviewer path byte-identical; net 0 SLOC) and tools/agent_supervisor/dual_review.py adds DualReviewConductor with the same .review(...) interface. Not wired into cli.py or the launchers yet (TW5).
D-091-R002: When enabled, the conductor runs the Codex and Claude reviewers independently on the same frozen packet (neither sees the other) inside one atomic review slot (ReviewSlots, never a third concurrent review); a reviewer that raises, times out or returns malformed output makes the combined verdict UNVERIFIED, never PASS (M0-T168 N1).
D-091-R003: The conductor combines both reviews with the accepted review_combiner (verdict = the worse of the two, computed in code; model disputes advisory), resolves every model against its allowlist before any slot or process, and refuses when the combining model is unset (D-091-R008 stays the owner's choice); disputed findings and verdicts are surfaced in the loop report for the human gate and the loop records no gate (ADR-005).
D-091-R007: Tests: tools/test_agent_supervisor_dual_review.py 17 passed (one class per acceptance scenario, fake reviewers, real loop and real combiner); reviewer, combiner, slots, bounded suites 372 passed.
